question: Town I is to the east of Town X. Town L is to the west of Town X. Town N is to the north of Town L. Town P is to the north-east of Town L. Town P is to the east of Town N. Town I is to the south-west of Town P. What is the position of Town P with respect to Town X?
solution:
Given: 

Town I is to the east of Town X.

Town L is to the west of Town X.

Town N is to the north of Town L.

Town P is to the north-east of Town L.

Town P is to the east of Town N.

Town I is to the south-west of Town P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cea5d04ce5fbb842cd0af10479aecbd057af2c8d86ebcbab55c8640dc0d450e3.png] 

So, Town P is in 'North-east' direction with respect to Town X

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
